title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.7

## Stable release

Navimower Map Card 0.3.7 continues the move toward a **lighter presentation layer**.

More task policy, retained state and expensive map preparation now comes from the Navimower integration, while the card focuses on rendering, interaction and responsive UI.

## Highlights

### New LiDAR terrain and elevation overlay

0.3.7 adds a selectable LiDAR layer for supported mowers:

- None;
- LiDAR terrain;
- LiDAR elevation;
- adjustable opacity.

The terrain image is provided through the authenticated Navimower backend and aligned directly to mower-local map bounds.

LiDAR also works per mower inside the existing Multi-mower Site view, including mixed sites where only some mowers expose terrain resources.

Visibility is based on the integration-provided terrain capability/resource rather than hard-coded model names.

### Prepared backend rendering pipeline

The card progressively consumes the new backend-prepared resources introduced in Navimower 0.4.5:

- prepared static/layout resources;
- backend current-cycle artifacts;
- prepared live-route backbone plus short live tail;
- prepared retained History resources;
- semantic cutting/travel routes.

Compatibility fallbacks remain for older supported integration responses.

### Cutting vs travel trail

Live movement can now be rendered differently depending on backend semantics.

Actual cutting keeps the wider mowing appearance, while travel/transit can use a thinner centerline.

This avoids visually painting areas as newly mowed just because the mower drove through them.

### History as a non-destructive overlay

Selecting a History session highlights that session without hiding the surrounding mowing context.

Current/day trails and relevant current-cycle artifacts remain visible, while the selected session receives a short glow/pulse for emphasis.

The pulse is click-driven and no longer restarts simply because the map rerendered.

### Native / North-up / Custom orientation

0.3.7 adds a full scene-orientation system:

- Native;
- North up;
- Custom rotation.

Mower-local geometry and existing map underlays remain aligned while labels, dock artwork and the legend stay readable.

Underlay bounds are rotation-aware to avoid blank corners.

The existing 0.3.6 underlays — OpenStreetMap, Google Satellite and Maa- ja Ruumiamet Ortofoto/Hübriid — remain supported.

### Backend-owned Resume UI

The card now consumes the integration's task-resume decision instead of inferring resumability from mower state.

When Resume is available, the card calls the higher-level navimower.continue_task action.

When it is not available, Mow can use the full primary action row.

### Weather-aware presentation

The card can show integration-composed presentation states such as **Raining** and **Rain delay** while keeping the canonical Home Assistant mower activity for controls and motion semantics.

### Better viewport behavior

Backend map refreshes no longer reset the user's pan/zoom position.

A real interaction-owned auto-reset can return the map to its initial view after **30 seconds** of inactivity, and this behavior can be disabled in the card editor.

This makes it much easier to stay zoomed into one area while watching the mower.

### Quick settings

The user-facing Settings dialog/button is now called **Quick settings**.

Existing YAML/internal keys remain unchanged for compatibility.

### Consolidated runtime

The previous cumulative patch-style runtime has been consolidated into one canonical source file with a deterministic production build.

This reduces duplicated wrappers and gives future card development a cleaner, easier-to-test base.

## Existing 0.3.6 features carried forward

The following were already part of the previous stable line and remain supported:

- Multi-mower Site view;
- OpenStreetMap;
- Google Satellite;
- Maa- ja Ruumiamet Ortofoto;
- Maa- ja Ruumiamet Hübriid.

0.3.7 builds on that foundation rather than introducing those features for the first time.

## Recommended pairing

Navimower Map Card 0.3.7 is designed to pair with Navimower 0.4.5 so it can use the latest prepared resources, semantic trail, Resume policy and LiDAR capability contracts.

Thanks to everyone who tested the beta line and reported browser, model and map-alignment issues.
